newsitem.title: USA: Globalstar sets stock purchase rights.
newsitem.headline: Globalstar sets stock purchase rights.

text.p: Globalstar Telecommunications Ltd on Friday said it is to distribute to shareholders rights to buy one share for each 8.84 owned as part of a plan to exercise warrants for 5.32 millon shares at $26.50 per share.

The firm will receive $140.9 million to continue developing its satellite telecommunications system under the plan. The warrants were issued in April 1996 in connection with the guarantee of a $250 million Globalstar bank agreement.
Warrant holders include Loral Space & Communications Ltd, Lockheed Martin Corp, Daimler-Benz AG and Qualcomm Inc.
Globalstar said it reached agreement with the warrant holders so the warrants can be exercised and the shares registered for prompt resale.
The rights being distributed will not be listed, however the company expects shareholders to be able to trade them over the counter.
Globalstar already said on Thursday it will raise $250 million in senior notes and warrants in a private offering. The company has previously raised $1.4 billion for its satellite systems.
